cleanup_interpretation: Owned direct child reaped and process group empty; endpoint pruned only after release. The whole-harness cleanup_confirmed field is false because startup failed before uvicorn was created, so its shutdown flag was never set. No HTTP server or generation request started.
diagnosis: Torch model-class import reached its Dynamo cache-root utility, which called first-use tempfile.gettempdir(). The stdlib probe writes four bytes; RLIMIT_FSIZE(0,0) correctly refused it in every fallback directory. This is a production startup incompatibility, not a model generation failure.
repair: Explicitly select the existing validated owner-private IPC root as child tempfile.tempdir and TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR before FSIZE(0). No new directory, global owner cache, nonempty file-write exception, native-import ordering change or expanded cleanup authority.

synthetic_verification.regression: Real worker.main and actual Linux fences with synthetic sealed-input and loader stubs reproduced the same FileNotFoundError before the repair. After repair, first-use temp selection succeeds, ambient cache selection is overwritten, nonempty file writes still raise EFBIG, and only the fixed socket entry remains. No Torch/Transformers import or inference.
synthetic_verification.lint: Ruff check and format checks passed for all three changed Python files; git diff --check passed.

all_qwen_checks.scope: All nine Qwen3 unit/integration test files; synthetic runtime, owned processes and protocol/lifecycle checks, not actual model inference.

limitations: The repaired managed loader, native streaming, representative prompt capacity, cold/warm latency, cancellation/recovery and owner/handoff behavior still require a fresh exact-source actual acceptance run. Prior CI is not evidence that this runtime failure was absent. Full M2 and persistent STT remain open.
